description: Operational health, performance and capacity of one Harbor Trivy scanner installation. Security findings remain in Harbor.

panels.description: Scanner replicas successfully scraped by Prometheus. Fewer than expected: check pod readiness, Service endpoints, and scrape target errors.
panels.title: Reachable replicas

panels.description: Replicas exposing scanner operational metrics. If reachable replicas are missing here, check their adapter versions and metrics configuration.
panels.title: Instrumented replicas

panels.description: Workers currently processing scan tasks, including preparation and report persistence. Check Worker utilization and queue wait to assess remaining capacity.
panels.title: Active workers

panels.description: Successful artifact vulnerability scans per minute, averaged over the last 5 minutes across scanner replicas. Excludes failed scans and SBOM generation. Rescanning an artifact counts again.
panels.title: Artifact scans per minute

panels.description: Average duration of successful artifact vulnerability scans completed in the selected time range, across scanner replicas. Includes preparation and report storage; excludes queue wait and SBOM generation. No value means no completed scans were observed.
panels.title: Average scan duration (selected range)

panels.description: Successful execution attempts during the selected range. Retries mean this is not a count of unique images.
panels.title: Successful attempts (selected range)

panels.description: Failed execution attempts during the selected range, including attempts that are later retried successfully.
panels.title: Failed attempts (selected range)

panels.description: Time since any replica last completed a task successfully. Investigate if this grows while scans are waiting; growth while idle is normal.
panels.title: Since last success

panels.description: Running adapter and Trivy CLI versions per replica. Check for unexpected versions or mixed versions after a rollout.
panels.title: Adapter and engine versions

panels.description: Dashboard scope and links to metric definitions and troubleshooting.

options.content:
Scanner availability, capacity, and execution health for the selected installation. Runtime includes Trivy subprocesses.

[Metric definitions and empty-panel troubleshooting](https://github.com/container-registry/harbor-scanner-trivy/blob/main/deploy/chart/dashboards/README.md).

panels.title: About this dashboard

panels.description: CPU cores consumed per scanner pod, including Trivy subprocesses and sidecars. Compare with throttling and execution latency when assessing CPU capacity.

targets.expr: label_replace(label_replace((sum by (pod) ((max by (cluster,namespace,pod,container) (rate(container_cpu_usage_seconds_total{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",container!="",container!="POD",image!=""}[$__rate_interval]))) and on (cluster,namespace,pod) max by (cluster,namespace,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}))), "replica", "$1", "pod", "(.*)"), "replica", "$1", "pod", "harbor-scanner-(.*)")

panels.description: Shows containers whose last recorded termination was OOMKilled. The termination may predate the selected range; check restart timing and memory limits. Other termination reasons are omitted. Empty results can also mean no termination history or missing kube-state-metrics.

panels.description: p95 peak RSS of completed Trivy subprocesses, grouped by command. Use for memory sizing alongside worker concurrency; simultaneous scans require additional memory.
panels.title: Child peak RSS (p95)

options.content:
**Harbor queue → Adapter queue → Active worker**

The panels below show current queue age, p95 wait before first start, and elapsed running time. They measure different tasks and cannot be added together.

panels.description: Current wait of the next IMAGE_SCAN task before Harbor dispatches it. Covers all scanners in the selected Harbor installation.
panels.title: Harbor: next queued scan age

panels.description: Enqueue-to-first-start wait for tasks that started in the recent window. Excludes Harbor scheduling and retries; empty if no tasks started.
panels.title: Adapter: wait before first start (p95)

panels.description: Elapsed time of the oldest running task per replica, including report processing. Zero when idle. This is running time, not queue wait.
panels.title: Worker: oldest active scan age

panels.description: Completed execution attempts per minute, including retries. This is not a count of unique images.
panels.title: Worker execution rate

panels.description: Time spent processing completed attempts, including target resolution, scanning and report persistence. Queue wait is excluded.
panels.title: Worker execution duration (p95)

panels.description: Busy workers as a share of configured concurrency, per replica. Sustained saturation with rising queue wait warrants reviewing worker capacity and scan duration.
panels.title: Worker utilization

panels.description: Failed execution attempts by stage and cause. Retries can produce more than one failure for a scan request.
panels.title: Worker failure categories

panels.description: Worker ownership decisions per minute. lock_busy means another worker owns the delivery; lock_error and decode_error prevent processing.
panels.title: Adapter dispatch outcomes

panels.description: Durable deliveries awaiting acknowledgement, including queued and in-progress work. Shared queue sampled between scans; values can lag while all workers are busy.
panels.title: Adapter unacknowledged deliveries

panels.description: Duration of completed Trivy child processes. Excludes adapter queueing, report transformation and persistence.
panels.title: Trivy CLI duration (p95)

panels.description: Adapter lookups of Harbor SBOM accessories and reuse/fallback decisions. A task can emit several events; this is not the Trivy analysis-cache hit rate.
panels.title: SBOM reuse decisions

panels.description: Completed child processes by exit reason. A signal does not establish OOM; check the container OOM panel. HTTP server shutdown errors are outside this metric.
panels.title: Trivy CLI exit reasons

panels.description: Configured timeout for each Trivy child process. Total worker execution can take longer.
panels.title: Trivy CLI timeout

panels.description: Status of db/trivy.db and its metadata.json on each scanner pod. Trivy uses this local database to match packages against known vulnerabilities. Redis analysis caching does not replace this file.

It replaces the local fanal/fanal.db cache; evicted analysis can be recomputed. db/trivy.db and java-db/trivy-java.db remain on each pod's local volume. panels.description: Adapter connections to the job/report Redis/Valkey, usually Harbor’s existing instance. All scanner pods share its queue, delivery leases, job state and scan reports. The dedicated analysis cache uses separate connections. Total includes idle connections; compare with pool waits and timeouts.
panels.title: Job/report Redis pool connections

panels.description: Redis connection-pool wait timeouts per minute. Nonzero values can interrupt job coordination and persistence; check pool contention and Redis responsiveness.
panels.title: Job/report Redis pool timeouts

panels.description: Mean Redis connection wait among requests that waited. Empty when no waits occurred. Rising waits and timeouts indicate connection-pool pressure.
panels.title: Job/report Redis pool wait

panels.description: Filesystem capacity unavailable to the scanner, including other files and reserved space. High utilization can block database updates and report writes. Do not sum shared mounts.
panels.title: Filesystem utilization

panels.description: Free space on the local database and report filesystems. Redis analysis caching still needs this disk space. Paths may share a mount.
panels.title: Available filesystem space

panels.description: Available filesystem inodes. Exhaustion blocks file creation even with free disk space. Empty where inode accounting is unsupported.
panels.title: Available inodes

panels.description: Local database file sizes, also required with Redis analysis caching. Requires cacheSizeEnabled; missing paths or failed collection omit values.
panels.title: Vulnerability DB and Java index sizes

panels.description: Time to disk exhaustion projected from a six-hour free-space trend. Empty without a declining trend or 60 samples. Reassess after cleanup, resizing, or workload changes.
panels.title: Estimated time to full

panels.description: p95 report payload size before and after compression. Rising sizes increase persistence and retrieval workload. Empty without recent report writes.
panels.title: Report size (p95)

panels.description: Raw report bytes divided by compressed bytes for recent writes. Higher means better compression. Empty without recent report writes.
panels.title: Compression ratio

panels.description: Confirmed job/report payload bytes written per second, split by encoding. Use to assess persistence traffic; raw and compressed represent the same writes and must not be added.
panels.title: Applied payload write rate

panels.description: Harbor report polls per minute by result. pending is expected during scanning; investigate persistent error or not_found responses. not_found can indicate expiry or an unknown job ID.
panels.title: Report fetch outcomes

panels.description: p95 delay between task completion and successful report retrieval. Rising delay warrants checking Harbor polling and jobservice health. Empty without recent successful fetches.
panels.title: Successful report fetch age (p95)

panels.description: Configured Redis retention for scan jobs and reports, refreshed by writes. Check when Harbor receives not_found for previously valid jobs.
panels.title: Effective report retention TTL

panels.description: Adapter Redis store operations per minute by operation and outcome. Investigate error outcomes; not_found and not_applied indicate missing records or conditional writes that did not apply.
panels.title: Store operation outcomes

panels.description: p95 adapter store-operation latency. Rising latency can delay task completion and report retrieval; check Redis load, connection waits, and network latency.
panels.title: Store latency (p95)

panels.description: Adapter HTTP requests per minute by route and status, excluding probes and scrapes. Investigate unexpected error responses; report polling can produce many requests per scan.
panels.title: API request rate

panels.description: p95 adapter HTTP response time by route. Rising latency warrants checking report handling and persistence. Scan execution time is measured separately.
panels.title: API latency (p95)

panels.description: Current Go heap allocation in the adapter process. If pod memory grows while this stays flat, investigate Trivy subprocesses and filesystem cache.
panels.title: Adapter Go heap

panels.description: IMAGE_SCAN tasks waiting in Harbor jobservice, across scanner registrations. A growing backlog warrants checking jobservice workers and scanner capacity.
panels.title: Harbor scan queue size

panels.description: Processed Harbor IMAGE_SCAN tasks per minute by jobservice status, across scanner registrations. Compare failures with adapter outcomes to distinguish orchestration from execution problems.
panels.title: Harbor scan job outcomes

panels.description: Logs from the selected scanner pods. Use to investigate scan progress, database downloads, and failures. Requires matching Loki labels; deleted pods fall out of discovery.
panels.title: Scanner logs

panels.description: Scanner log lines matching error, fatal, or panic. Inspect messages alongside execution failures; keyword matches can include harmless output.
panels.title: Scanner errors

panels.description: Local image/layer analysis cache in fanal/fanal.db under Trivy's cache directory. Redis replaces this cache; leftover fanal.db files are inactive and excluded. Requires the filesystem backend and cacheSizeEnabled.
panels.title: Filesystem analysis cache size

panels.description: Whether the adapter could check vulnerability DB and Java index metadata and obtain the Trivy version. A missing database can be a valid check result; this does not test database integrity.
panels.title: DB metadata checks

panels.description: Time since the last successful metadata check. A growing value means database status panels may be stale; this is not database content age.
panels.title: Time since DB metadata refresh

panels.description: Each collector shows its latest result and time since its last successful measurement. A rising last-success age means disk metrics are no longer being refreshed, even if the last result was Collected. Database disk holds db/trivy.db and java-db/trivy-java.db; Report disk holds temporary scan output. File sizes is optional and excludes inactive fanal/fanal.db when Redis caching is used. Not reported can mean collection is disabled. Failed means measurements were unavailable, not that storage failed.

targets.expr: (min by (pod,collector) ((harbor_scanner_trivy_storage_collection_success{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}"} and on (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod,instance) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""} == 1)) or on (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod,collector) (label_replace((max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) * 0 - 1), "collector", "cache_filesystem", "pod", ".*") or label_replace((max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) * 0 - 1), "collector", "reports_filesystem", "pod", ".*") or label_replace((max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) * 0 - 1), "collector", "cache_size", "pod", ".*")))) or label_replace((max by (pod,collector) ((time() - harbor_scanner_trivy_storage_last_success_timestamp_seconds{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}"}) or on (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod,collector) (label_replace((max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) * 0 - 1), "collector", "cache_filesystem", "pod", ".*") or label_replace((max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) * 0 - 1), "collector", "reports_filesystem", "pod", ".*") or label_replace((max by (cluster,namespace,scanner,pod) (up{cluster=~"${cluster:regex}",namespace=~"${namespace:regex}",scanner=~"${scanner:regex}",pod!=""}) * 0 - 1), "collector", "cache_size", "pod", ".*")))), "collector", "$1-age", "collector", "(.*)")

panels.title: Disk metric collection

panels.description: Whether the adapter could collect local disk measurements. Database disk contains db/trivy.db, java-db/trivy-java.db and, with filesystem caching, fanal/fanal.db. Report disk holds temporary scan output. Failed means measurements were unavailable, not that storage failed. File sizes appear only when collection is enabled.
panels.title: Disk metric collection history

panels.description: Compare database content age and local file presence across replicas. Use the status tables above for current update policy and timing.
panels.title: Database freshness history

panels.description: Age of the vulnerability content installed in db/trivy.db, read from db/metadata.json. Age rises between updates; a drop means newer content was installed. Investigate a replica falling behind during active vulnerability scanning.
panels.title: Vulnerability DB content age

panels.description: Age of the Java package index installed in java-db/trivy-java.db, read from java-db/metadata.json. Age rises between updates; a drop means newer content was installed. Investigate a replica falling behind during scans that need the Java index.
panels.title: Java index content age

panels.description: Presence of db/trivy.db and valid db/metadata.json on each pod. Persistent absence blocks vulnerability scanning until a database is downloaded or supplied. Gaps mean no observations; presence does not verify database integrity.
panels.title: Vulnerability DB presence

panels.description: Presence of java-db/trivy-java.db and valid java-db/metadata.json on each pod. Absence can be normal until Java package identification needs the index. Gaps mean no observations; presence does not verify database integrity.
panels.title: Java index presence
